The '''Sarin sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near the [[Parmel sector/Legends|Parmel sector]]. It was also called '''Sector 242'''. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the Sarin sector included [[Parein II 4/Legends|Parein II 4]] and [[Seylott/Legends|Seylott]].
